classification: finite CPU study of sensor-visible tool contact; not hidden, hardware, real-time, or safety proof
ground_truth_policy: f_tool is offline scoring only; a pick offset without f_tool > 1 N is a nuisance negative, not a contact
fit_policy: thresholds may use calibration_normal only; no offset/contact/external-force outcomes enter fitting
gates: candidate uses no f_tool, offset, external-force schedule, or future sample at runtime
all calibration normals and all genuine no-contact offset nuisances add zero false rises
every old genuine contact is detected without prealarm within 120 ms
fresh cases are scored by actual f_tool: genuine contacts must be detected; no-contact offsets must remain quiet
all base R22 detections on strong external-force checks are preserved with no extra attributable rise
unsupported/servo behavior is unchanged because the extension is torque-only
stop_rule: If normal-only sensor features do not separate genuine contacts from no-contact nuisance mechanics with the gates above, publish counterexamples and no candidate.
